title: Gang Members as Models
content: Gang members may look intimidating, but if you catch them in public places, they make great models.Two Young Gang Members,published inThe Artist's Guide to SketchingThis idea applies to goths, bikers, punkers, ravers, metalheads & bodybuilders.In my experience they’re keenly aware of the effect their appearance has on ordinary, mundane people. They know it’s a costume, either temporary or permanent (as in the case of body modifications).More on Substack
